'''Silver''' (Japanese: '''シルバー''' ''Silver'') is an adult [[Pokémon Trainer]] and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HS18|The Search for the Legend]]''. He currently resides on [[One Island]].

[[File:Young Silver.png|thumb|left|220px|Silver in his youth, after seeing Moltres]]
Silver is extremely powerful and has a strong body to match his strong Pokémon. However, he can be very arrogant and his threatening nature often leads to his eviction from public places. He calls [[Ritchie]] "half-pint" and various synonyms throughout the episode.

Silver has a fascination with {{p|Moltres}}, stemming back to when he saw it one night when he was just a boy. From that day, his ultimate goal was to find and {{pkmn|battle}} the [[legendary birds|legendary bird]]. [[Butch]] and [[Cassidy]] of [[Team Rocket]] made use of this in a plan to capture Moltres but Silver stopped them when he learned their full plan. He did get to have the battle he had dreamed of but it had to be abandoned half-way through due to the eruption of the volcano they were on. Deciding he could wait a little longer, Silver stayed on the island in hopes of battling Moltres when it returned.

==Trivia==
* According to [[Butch]], Silver has been kicked out of three hotels, two shops, and one [[Pokémon Center]].
* When [[Ritchie]] mentions {{Ash}}, Silver's reaction suggests that he knows him, despite the fact that he has never met Ash onscreen.
* Similar to Ash, Silver saw a {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{2t|Fire|Flying}} Pokémon when he was young, owns a [[first partner Pokémon]] that rides on his shoulder, and has a draconic Pokémon that serves as a strong battler.
